title.zh: 刑事事项互助（印度尼西亚共和国）命令 2008
title.en: Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters (Republic of Indonesia) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters (Republic of Indonesia) Order 2008 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 9th September 2008.

heading.en: Declaration of Republic of Indonesia as prescribed foreign country

text.en: 2. The Republic of Indonesia is hereby declared as a prescribed foreign country for the purposes of Part III of the Act.
